title: Half-visible characters
subtitle: The Fifth Plateau
intro: The words on the screen melt, then surface somewhere else. Hold the ones about to scatter; catch six and you can finish this page.
closing: Does "afterglow" really exist? He does not dare answer.

words.note: He catches the two words "after" and "glow"; they scatter between his fingers.
The five senses collapse like wax.
Time is pulled into a very thin thread.
The name dissolves on his tongue.
The characters crawl across the screen.
He does not know where he is standing.
Someone very far away is asking him something.
There seems to be another pair of eyes behind the screen.
